releases.summary: One Learn section for articles, talks, books and quizzes, with search and your own Saved list.
highlights: Learn: articles, talks, books and quizzes in one place, with one search (quotes too).
New quizzes to check your understanding, with points for trying and passing.
✓ marks what you've finished, ◐ what's in progress, and ★ Save keeps your own list.

items.text: Learn shows the top 5 articles, talks, books and quizzes, with "See all" lists you can filter by topic and status and sort.
Search finds the best articles, talks, books, quizzes and quotes; narrow to one type with the chips.
Quizzes: 10 questions, shuffled each time; pass with 8. Passing shows every answer; otherwise review the questions you missed and try again after a short wait. After 3 tries all answers are shown.
Quiz points: 5 for the first try and 2 for each try after; passing adds 25 (1st try), 15 (2nd) or 10 (3rd).
★ Save for later: your own list that stays until you unsave it (also for favourites).
Continue: books you're reading, quizzes you're working on and saved things not yet done.
Talks have their own page with a picture, "Watch" and "✓ I watched it"; Related items under every article, talk and book.
New challenge: Pass 5 quizzes in 60 days.
Library: full article text editor, topics (up to 3), 📌 Pin to the top 5, quizzes with a question editor and a Review screen to approve them.
Eleven draft quizzes written from published SOS sources, each question with its source, ready for review.
Anonymous counts per item (opened, finished, passed). No names are recorded.
The Learn articles that were built into Copilot are now in the Library, so admins can edit them; everything you read keeps its ✓.
The app's own help articles moved to "Help with the app".

releases.summary: A quick fix for the News page.
highlights: The News page shows all articles again.

items.text: News: the article list and year headings were replaced by the footer's year (introduced in v0.20). Added a test so it can't happen again.

releases.summary: Reading and video challenges, event type icons, and a simpler, steadier sosmn.org.
highlights: Copilot: reading and video challenges, with books by the Masters and talks to watch.
Every event shows its type and says FREE; new visitor guidelines.
Your details: choose the name we use, add your ZIP code, or ask for no messages.

items.text: Copilot reading and watching challenges: Daily Thought (30 days), an article a week, a book a chapter at a time, and talks (3 a week). Catching up is always allowed.
Copilot: "✓ I read it" on the Thought for today, "Mark as read" on Learn articles, book chapters with a finish celebration (+100 points), "✓ Watched" for talks, and "Your reading" in Learn.
Copilot: when you finish a challenge you can choose to let the center know (only its name and date are shared).
sosmn.org: an icon for each event type (Public Intro, Workshop, Satsang, Retreat, Darshan, Festival, Celebration), or a small picture of the flyer.
sosmn.org: "All our programs are free" on the event lists, and FREE on every event.
sosmn.org: each event says whether a children's program is offered.
sosmn.org: Visitor guidelines page (video monitoring, photography, quiet during meditation, children, check-in).
Your details: editable name, optional ZIP code, "Please don't send me any messages", and a short privacy note.
Library tab: books (look up details from an Amazon link or ISBN), talks and article links; only approved items appear in Copilot.
Challenges: new Education type (what to read or watch, pace, total, points each), and four starter reading/video challenges.
People stages (Potential, New, Seeker, Satsangi, Initiate) and status (Active, Drifted, Dropped, Passive, Declined), Sevadar flag, ZIP code and both names on the person page.
Seeker orientation progress (5 workshops, 2 challenges); Follow-ups for "orientation done" and "ready to be Satsangi?".
Events: one Audience (Public, Community, Initiates) instead of "Who can see it" and "Mainly for"; children's program checkbox; event types updated.
The header (logo and menu) stays in the same place on every page.
A much shorter footer.
The phone/computer layout switch is now a small icon in the header.
About page: shorter, clearer directions; duplicate links removed.
What's new in the apps shows a few highlights; full notes are on the admin site and GitHub.
"Seeker friend" is now called Satsangi; Community events are for Satsangis and Initiates.
the event's flyer now shows on its admin page.

releases.summary: A new 21-day meditation path in Copilot, and seeker-journey tools for the center team.

items.text: 21-Day Foundation in Copilot: sit 10, 15 or 20 minutes every day for 21 days. When you finish, continue or take the 21-Day Advance, growing to 30 minutes.
When you start using Copilot, you choose your first challenge: the 21-Day Foundation or attending 6 sessions in 3 months.
What's new page, and the version number in the footer.
Follow-ups: people to thank, check on or welcome back, with ready-to-edit messages.
Journey: everyone's level (New, Seeker L2–L4, Initiate), drifting, and a person page with timeline, mentor, notes and milestones.
Event type and "mainly for" on every event, and an Insight tab (opened → going → came, first-timers, came back).
Challenge settings: minute choices, grow-to, next step, offered at sign-up.
Clearer "How challenges work" on the Roadmap: the 21-day path, missed days, attending sessions and points.

releases.summary: Where we started: everything built before Nov 2026, summarized.

items.text: sosmn.org is the center's events site: upcoming events, a calendar, RSVP (with guests), add to your calendar, and check-in at the center.
Meditation Copilot lives at sosmn.org/copilot: meditation timer, your roadmap to 10,000 hours, challenges, insights, rewards, Learn and a Thought for today.
News & archive: 28 stories from the center since 2007, plus an About page with directions.
Sign in with Google or Microsoft. Phone and computer layouts, with a switch in the footer.
Admin site: events, RSVPs, check-in with door code and QR, invitations, people, challenges, team and activity log.
